L01: A membership runs from the day it is taken out.
L02: It is paid monthly by standing order.
L03: A member may cancel at any time.
L04: A cancellation is made in writing to the office.
L05: An electronic message counts as writing.
L06: The office confirms every cancellation in writing.
L07: A member who cancels keeps access until the paid period ends.
L08: No part month is refunded.
L09: A member may instead freeze the membership for up to three months.
L10: A frozen membership is not charged.
L11: A freeze is requested the same way as a cancellation.
L12: A cancelled membership may be taken out again at the going rate.
L13: The going rate is the rate on the day it is taken out again.
